---
title: "Intensity-gated GEM diffusion analysis"
output: html_document
---

Supplementary analysis script for Fig 6B–D. Performs intensity-gated GEM diffusion
analysis using per-trajectory data from
[GemSpa (napari-gemspa)](https://github.com/liamholtlab/napari-gemspa).

Analysis steps:

1. From proliferating-cell GEM data, define the intensity window consistent
   with monomeric 40 nm-GEMs (single-particle intensity distribution).
2. Restrict MSD / Deff analysis to trajectories within the monomer window.
3. Recompute Deff(100 ms) and anomalous exponent alpha for WT vs rim15KO in
   the monomer population → `analyses/output/gem_monomer_deff.pdf`.
